channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Barcelona oo 0-2 ka soo noqotay, 3-2 ku garaacday Villarreal, hoggaankana 3 dhibcood ku kordhisay
item.description: Barcelona ayaa Axaddii ka soo kabatay 2-0 ay nasashada ku hoos jirtay, waxayna 3-2 ku garaacday Villarreal, iyadoo saddex gool dhalisay 10 daqiiqo gudahood, taasoo hoggaanka La Liga 3 dhibcood ugu kordhisay Real Madrid.

item.title: Marc Márquez oo ku guuleystay horyaalkiisii 8-aad ee MotoGP, la simay Giacomo Agostini
item.description: Marc Márquez ayaa Axaddii ku guuleystay horyaalkiisii 8-aad ee MotoGP, isagoo kaalinta 8-aad ku dhammeystay Grand Prix-ga Portugal, taasoo la siman rikoorka Talyaaniga Giacomo Agostini.

item.title: Wasiir Fiqi oo ciidamada xoogga dalka ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan qabyaaladda iyo ku biirista jabhadaha
item.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Axaddii ciidamada qaranka ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan qabyaaladda iyo ku biirista jabhadaha, isagoo ka hadlayay munaasabad lagu soo bandhigayay dib-u-dhiska ciidanka badda.

item.title: Tottenham oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Man City WSL, rikoorkii guriga ee Jeglertz oo burburay
item.description: Kooxda haweenka Tottenham ayaa Axaddii 3-1 ku garaacday Manchester City garoonka Joie Stadium ee Women's Super League, taasoo soo afjartay rikoorkii guusha buuxda ee City ay gurigeeda ku lahayd.

item.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Muqdisho kula kulmay wafdi ka socda shirkadda shidaalka ee Aljeeriya SONATRACH
item.description: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Axaddii Madaxtooyada Muqdisho ku qaabilay wafdi ka socda SONATRACH, shirkadda dowladda Aljeeriya ee shidaalka iyo gaaska, si looga wada hadlo iskaashi dhinaca khayraadka dabiiciga ah.

item.title: Shirka cimilada COP31 oo Antalya ku dhammaaday heshiis la'aan, kaddib khilaaf ku saabsan shidaalka
item.description: Shirka sannadlaha ah ee Qaramada Midoobay ee isbeddelka cimilada COP31, oo ka socday Antalya ee Turkiga, ayaa Axaddii ku soo idlaaday iyadoo aan la gaarin heshiis guud, kaddib khilaaf ku saabsan ka guurista shidaalka.

item.title: WAR CUSUB: Galmudug oo maanta lagu dhawaaqayo Golaha Wasiirrada cusub, khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo mid beeleedna laga cabsi qabo
item.description: Dhismaha Golaha Wasiirrada cusub ee Galmudug ayaa maanta si weyn isha loogu hayaa, iyadoo la filayo in Madaxweynaha maamulka Galmudug, Liibaan Cabdi Xasan, uu ku dhawaaqo xubnaha cusub ee Golaha Wasiirrada.

item.title: Timon Haugan oo ku guuleystay slalom-ka Gurgl, Pinheiro Braathen oo ka dhacay
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka Norway Timon Haugan ayaa Axaddii ku guuleystay tartanka slalom-ka Koobka Adduunka ee barafka ee Gurgl ee Austria, kaddib markii Lucas Pinheiro Braathen oo Brazil u ciyaara uu tartanka ka baxay.

item.title: Bayern Munich oo walaac ka qabta Jamal Musiala oo mar kale la kulmay miyir-beel kooban
item.description: Jamal Musiala, xiddigga Bayern Munich, ayaa warbixinno la daabacay Axaddii lagu sheegay inuu Isniintii hore mar kale la kulmay miyir-beel kooban, inkastoo uu Jimcihii dib ugu soo laabtay garoonka Bundesliga.

item.title: Juventus oo 4-0 ku jebisay Venezia, afar gool 18 daqiiqo gudahood ah
item.description: Juventus ayaa Axaddii 4-0 ku garaacday Venezia kulankii toddobaadka 12-aad ee Serie A ee garoonka Allianz Stadium, iyadoo dhammaan goolasha ay dhalisay qaybtii labaad.

item.title: Isbarbardhigga Waxqabadka Labada Dowladood ee Soomaaliya: 2017–2022 iyo 2022–2026
item.description: Labadii maamul ee Madaxweyne Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo (2017–2022) iyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud (2022–2026) waxay dalka ku hoggaamiyeen marxalado kala duwan, kuwaas oo mid walba lahaa fursado, caqabado siyaasadeed, mudnaano dowladeed iyo natiijooyin u gaar ah.

item.title: Watford oo shaqada ka eriyay tababaraha Alessio Dionisi kaddib 18 kulan
item.description: Kooxda Watford ee horyaalka Championship ee England ayaa Axaddii shaqada ka eriday tababarahooda Alessio Dionisi, kaddib 18 kulan oo keliya, maalin kaddib guuldarro 4-0 ah oo ay kala kulantay Sheffield United.

item.title: PSG oo xaqiijisay in Désiré Doué uu ka go'ay seed-ka jilibka, qalliin ayaana loo samayn doonaa
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain ayaa xaqiijisay in weeraryahankeeda Désiré Doué uu ka go'ay seed-ka hore ee jilibka midig (ACL) kulankii Ligue 1 ee Sabtida ay Nice kaga adkaadeen, qalliinna lagu samayn doono dhammaadka bisha kahor.

item.title: Verstappen oo ku guulaystay Las Vegas Grand Prix, Russell oo qalad sameeyay, Ferrari-na isku dhacday
item.description: Max Verstappen oo u ciyaara Red Bull ayaa ku guulaystay Las Vegas Grand Prix tartan aad u qasan oo hoggaanka uu 34 jeer gacmo beddelay, halka George Russell uu qalad muhiim ah sameeyay, labada darawal ee Ferrari-na ay isku dhaceen.

item.title: Inter Miami oo 3-0 looga adkaaday Columbus, Messi oo kaarka cas ka badbaaday kaddib muran
item.description: Inter Miami ayaa Sabtidii garoonkeeda 3-0 looga adkaaday Columbus Crew kulankii koowaad ee taxanaha saddexda kulan ee MLS Cup playoffs, iyadoo Lionel Messi uu ku jiray muran kaddib markii uu kubad ku tuuray ciyaaryahan kale.

item.title: Senator Faroole: muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha iyo baarlamaanka federaalka waa dhammaaday
item.description: Madaxweynihii hore ee Puntland, Senator Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Faroole, ayaa qoraal uu soo saaray Axaddan ku sheegay in muddo-xileedka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo labada aqal ee baarlamaanka federaalka uu dhammaaday.

item.title: Wasiirka Duulista Soomaaliya oo Montreal kula kulmay madaxda ICAO
item.description: Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Soomaaliya, Maxamed Faarax Nuux, ayaa magaalada Montreal ee Canada kaga qaybgalay Shirweynaha 7-aad ee Gaadiidka Cirka Adduunka, wuxuuna kulamo la yeeshay madaxda Hay'adda Duulista Rayidka Caalamiga ah (ICAO).

item.title: Warbixin caalami ah: dareenka amniga muwaadiniinta Soomaaliya oo lagu qiimeeyay 74%
item.description: Hay'adda cilmi-baarista ee Global Safety Report ayaa warbixin cusub ku sheegtay in dareenka badbaadada muwaadiniinta Soomaaliya lagu qiimeeyay 74%, taas oo dalka ka dhigaysa kan ugu sarreeya dalalka Afrika ee ka hooseeya Saxaraha.

item.title: Donyell Malen oo 4 gool dhaliyay, Roma oo 5-1 ku burburisay Parma
item.description: Weeraryahanka reer Holland ee Donyell Malen ayaa Sabtidii afar gool u dhaliyay Roma, oo 5-1 kaga adkaatay Parma kulan Serie A ah, isagoo 2026 gaaray 26 gool oo uu ku dhaliyay 27 kulan.

item.title: Madaxa Ferrari: isku dhaca Hamilton iyo Leclerc ee Las Vegas waa mid aan la aqbali karin
item.description: Madaxa kooxda Ferrari Fred Vasseur ayaa sheegay in isku dhacii ciyaaryahannadiisa Lewis Hamilton iyo Charles Leclerc ee Grand Prix-ga Las Vegas uu ahaa mid gebi ahaanba aan la aqbali karin.

item.title: Bruno Fernandes oo sheegay in Man Utd u bandhigtay heshiis cusub, balse wada-hadallada la hakiyay
item.description: Kabtanka Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, ayaa sheegay in naadigu u bandhigay heshiis cusub, balse uu dareemayo in hadda aysan ahayn waqtigii ku habboonaa ee laga wada hadli lahaa mustaqbalkiisa.

item.title: Carlos Alcaraz iyo Alexander Zverev oo maanta ku kulmaya finalka ATP Finals ee Turin
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz ayaa saddex set kaga adkaaday Ben Shelton semi-finalka ATP Finals, wuxuuna Axadda finalka magaalada Turin ee Talyaaniga kula ciyaari doonaa Alexander Zverev oo isna ka gudbay Daniil Medvedev.

item.title: Xoolo-dhaqato abaartu xoolaha ka laysay oo Mudug kalluumeysi ugu wareegay
item.description: Rag badan oo xoolo-dhaqato ah oo abaarihii isdaba-joogga ahaa ay xoolahooda ka laayeen gobolka Mudug ayaa u guuray xeebaha, halkaas oo ay ku barteen dabaasha iyo kalluumeysiga si ay noloshooda u maareeyaan.

item.title: Xasan Sheekh: Diyaar baan u ahay inaan mucaaradka guryahooda ugu tago si loo wada hadlo
item.description: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in dowladdu diyaar u tahay inay mucaaradka kula kulanto guryahooda, kaddib markii ay diideen martiqaadkii wada-hadalka ee dowladda.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo Muqdisho u soo wareejinaysa keydka tallaallada oo 30 sano ku jiray Kenya
item.description: Wasiirka Caafimaadka Soomaaliya, Dr. Cali Xaaji Aadan, ayaa sheegay in xarunta keydinta tallaallada dalka, oo in ka badan 30 sano laga maamulayay Kenya, dib loogu soo wareejinayo Muqdisho.

item.title: Lix garsoore oo ka tirsan Maxkamadda Sare oo dowladda federaalka dacwad uga gudbiyey Maxkamadda Bariga Afrika
item.description: Lix garsoore oo ka tirsan Maxkamadda Sare ee Soomaaliya, oo uu ku jiro guddoomiyihii xilka laga qaaday Baashe Yuusuf Axmed, ayaa dowladda federaalka dacwad uga gudbiyey Maxkamadda Caddaaladda Bariga Afrika (EACJ).

item.title: Boca Juniors oo ku guulaysatay Copa Sudamericana, koob caalami ah kii ugu horreeyay 18 sano
item.description: Boca Juniors ayaa Sabtidii 2-0 kaga adkaatay Atlético Mineiro finalka Copa Sudamericana ee lagu ciyaaray Barranquilla, Colombia, waxayna gaartay koobkii caalamiga ahaa ee ugu horreeyay tan iyo 2008.

item.title: Masar, Suudaan iyo Eritrea oo Aswan ka taageeray madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya
item.description: Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee Masar, Suudaan iyo Eritrea ayaa kulan saddex geesood ah oo ay ku yeesheen magaalada Aswan mar kale ku xaqiijiyey taageeradooda midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya, kana soo horjeestay maamullo ama maleeshiyaad barbar socda dowladda dhexe.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama oo 50 dhibcood dhaliyay, San Antonio Spurs oo New Orleans ku garaacday 114-91
item.description: Xiddigga San Antonio Spurs Victor Wembanyama ayaa dhaliyay 50 dhibcood iyo 19 rebound, iyadoo kooxdiisu NBA-da ku garaacday New Orleans Pelicans 114-91, waxqabad aan hore loogu arag taariikhda horyaalka.

item.title: PSG oo 3-2 kaga adkaatay Nice, balse Désiré Doué oo jilibka si xun uga dhaawacmay
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain ayaa Sabtidii 3-2 kaga guulaysatay Nice, taasoo ah guushoodii 12-aad oo isku xigta, balse farxadda waxaa hareeyay dhaawac culus oo jilibka midig ah oo soo gaaray Désiré Doué.
